_note: Curated 'fundamental' subset of the central skills repo that THIS product ships by default. Read at every snapshot refresh, so editing it takes effect without restarting the backend. default-snapshot.mjs keeps a compiled-in fallback used only if this file is missing or invalid. NOTE the curated filter applies ONLY to the builtin kit — skills from other registered sources (e.g. the auto-system engine plugin) are copied in full, which is why the auto-system skills are not listed here.
